requirements.note: Inset-grouped list, newest first. Each row shows show, title, date · minutes and Played/Unplayed text. The large title has a count subtitle under it.
An 'Unplayed only' UISwitch-style row filters the list and is remembered across relaunch. One tap while the list was animating did not register.
Shows tab lists all 12 shows with initials tiles and 'N episodes · M unplayed' counts that update. Tapping a show pushes that show's episodes, with its own Unplayed-only switch.

Detail shows show, title, date, length, summary and a full-width Play button. Play turns into Pause, the status reads 'Playing', and the episode is marked played. Very plain: there is no artwork and no playing indicator anywhere else.
Each row has a circle/check button that toggles played in place. There are no swipe actions; a horizontal swipe on a row opens the episode instead.

A '+' on rows and on the detail screen adds to Up Next. Removing works through a Remove button or swipe-to-delete. Reordering is only through Earlier/Later buttons in every row: no drag handles and no Edit mode.
Played state, Up Next contents and order all survived relaunch.

bugs: A horizontal swipe on an episode row opens the episode instead of showing swipe actions or doing nothing.
A right-swipe from mid-screen on the detail screen left a stuck half-transition for a moment: the page was shifted and scaled, with the previous list showing through.
One tap on the Unplayed-only switch right after marking an episode was dropped.
tells: Up Next reorders with 'Earlier'/'Later' text buttons and a 'Remove' button in every row, where iOS uses an Edit mode with drag handles. Each row is about 210 pt tall.
The list exposes elements as 'Link's with an extra horizontal scroll bar, which reads like web content.
No leading or trailing swipe actions on episode rows.
Mark-played and add-to-queue are bare blue glyph buttons stacked on the right of every row, which looks busy and unlike a system list.
At the largest text size, Shows rows break words mid-word ('Co / m- / mon Gro / und', 'epis / odes', 'un- / played') because the initials tile does not shrink.
At the largest text size, the row's played-circle glyph is clipped top and bottom, and the large-title subtitle truncates.
When the bar collapses, the inline title and its subtitle sit over the scrolling rows with little separation, so the two overlap visually.
The back button on the show screen is not exposed to accessibility.
Grey initials squares stand in for show artwork; the app is generic, with no identity.
The detail screen is a stack of grouped cells: the title is not emphasised and there is no artwork.
A.scroll: Smooth through 420 rows with no blank or popping rows, and scroll position is kept when switching tabs. Flinging and dragging felt like a normal list, though the collapsed nav-bar title overlaps the content behind it.

requirements.note: Newest-first list with generated show artwork, a show name eyebrow, title, date · minutes and an Unplayed/Played indicator. Pulling down reveals a search field.
An All episodes / Unplayed segmented control filters the list and updates the count. At the largest text size it adapts to an 'Unplayed only' switch.
Shows tab: 12 shows with artwork, episode and unplayed counts. Tapping one pushes a large-title show page with a header and its own filter.

Detail has large artwork, a serif title, the full date, minutes, summary, Play episode and Add to Up Next. Play marks the episode played, turns into Pause, shows 'Playing · simulated playback', and brings up a Now Playing mini-player with pause and close.
A row '…' menu (native UIMenu: Play, Mark played/unplayed, Add/Remove Up Next) plus native leading swipe (Mark played) and trailing swipe (Add to Up Next).
Up Next has an Edit button that shows delete controls and reorder handles; dragging a handle reordered rows. Swipe to remove works, and there is a total-minutes header.
Played state, queue contents, reorder and removal all survived relaunch. Playback state is not restored, which is reasonable.

tells: Rows carry both a disclosure chevron and a '…' button side by side, which is redundant.
The played-status glyph and its 'Unplayed'/'Played' label have an odd wide gap and indent.
The 'Stay curious.' marketing hero with a decorative serif and waveform takes up the top of the main screen; it looks editorial rather than system.
The mini-player is a flat full-width bar above the tab bar instead of the iOS 26+ tab-bar bottom accessory, and content is cut off hard under it.
Inconsistent fonts: a serif detail title against SF everywhere else.
B.scroll: Native-feeling list: slow drags and flings were smooth with no blank or late rows, the section header pins under the bar, and the scroll position held across tab switches.

why: B covers every requirement with native iOS mechanisms: UIMenu row actions, leading and trailing swipe actions, Edit-mode drag reordering, and a segmented filter. It adds a now-playing mini-player and adapts cleanly to the largest text size. A works functionally, but it reorders with Earlier/Later buttons, has no swipe actions, and a row swipe opens the episode. At large text it breaks words mid-word and clips glyphs, so it reads as a generic, partly web-like build.
